project_info.theme: Galaxy A56 5G Awesome Intelligence feature poster
project_info.color_palette: Off-white, black, silver, pastel blue-lilac-green gradient, soft UI colors

main_subject.detail: Minimal premium poster presenting two angled Galaxy A56 5G devices, one front and one back, with the front display showing Circle to Search with Google around a kitten wearing an orange knit hat.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic clean product render, airy Samsung ecommerce aesthetic, feature-led launch poster

composition_elements.text: The new Galaxy A56 5G / Awesome Intelligence / Circle to Search with Google
items: Top Left: Centered black title 'The new Galaxy A56 5G'.
Top Right: Minimal empty off-white space supporting the clean layout.
Bottom Left: Large gradient phrase 'Awesome Intelligence' shifting from blue to mint.
Bottom Right: Black text 'Circle to Search with Google' above small legal disclaimers.

Center/Background: One front-facing Galaxy A56 5G floating diagonally over one rear-view device; the display shows a kitten wearing an orange horned knit hat, a Google Circle to Search halo, and shopping-style result cards below.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Gentle matte reflections, clean ecommerce shadows, bright minimal premium atmosphere

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for Galaxy A56 5G Awesome Intelligence feature poster. Centerpiece is a floating front-and-back Galaxy A56 5G composition on an off-white background, with the front display showing a kitten in an orange knit hat highlighted by Circle to Search with Google and shopping cards below. Background is bright and minimal with lots of negative space. Surrounding elements: exact title 'The new Galaxy A56 5G', large gradient phrase 'Awesome Intelligence', black line 'Circle to Search with Google', and small gray legal disclaimers at the bottom. Technical style: photorealistic product render, soft studio lighting, gentle reflections and clean ecommerce shadows, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Use refs for the exact device color and demo UI. The airy white layout and the oversized gradient 'Awesome Intelligence' lockup are core to the visual fidelity.
